description: Record a correction in the FilmOS knowledge layer when the user contradicts something you asserted from it. Use this the moment a contradiction is stated — not at the end of the session, and not instead of accepting the correction in your answer. It stores the claim AND what is actually true, owned by the user who said it, so lab_wissen surfaces it first next time. It does not delete anything: a deleted false claim returns with the next ingestion, a corrected one does not. Quote the user's own wording for `korrektur` where you can.

behauptung.description: The claim that is wrong, as it was stated

korrektur.description: What is actually true — the user's wording where possible

quelle.description: The source_slug the wrong claim came from — take it from a lab_wissen hit. A source that does not exist is refused, not silently stored.

thema.description: Short topic, so the correction is findable later

url.description: Source URL of the claim, if a hit carried one

name: lab_widerruf
title: Record Correction
